note: Silhouette scores compare visible boundaries only, not internal geometry, wood, lighting or unseen surfaces. Original controls overall proportions; the accepted side guide directs the head/button join.

internal_features.inspection: Original and selected overlays plus true level head profiles checked against neutral render; topology, junction surface and slit depth independently validated.
internal_features.mitre: One continuous rounded meridian from the collar transition into the button underside; full-thickness oblique cut and solid floor preserved.
internal_features.finial: Rounded convex button sits directly on the head. No cylindrical seat, pedestal, neck ring or gap is exposed.
internal_features.collars: Three descending collar steps, preserved by exact profile comparison.
internal_features.lower_body: Concave stem, raised socket and flare are preserved. The foot has a flatter outer wall and softened lower edge; its declared ring edits are checked against the archived prior model.
internal_features.limits: The accepted side guide is art direction, not a recovered source camera. Boxwood pigment, surface relief and reflections are an unfinished reconstruction. Single-view evidence cannot determine hidden geometry uniquely.
